title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 030
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute compass and directions variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Round compass ring with a tilted inner diamond needle at the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic round compass dial with an inner diamond needle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for drafting or signpost icons when the outer ring and center needle matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a circular compass ring with a distinct inner needle diamond.

items.depicts_observation: Drafting compass outline with one ring hinge and two long pointed legs
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the geometry tool used for drawing circles rather than a map dial.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for navigation compasses when the two leg drafting tool form is visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot changes from a dial to a geometry compass with two long pointed legs.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted diamond compass marker with an inner crossed needle shape
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a compact compass marker without a surrounding ring.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round dial or drafting compass when the diamond body is the cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reduces the compass to one tilted diamond frame with an inner crossed needle.

items.depicts_observation: Signpost outline with two opposite arrow signs on a vertical pole
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a wayfinding signpost rather than a compass shaped direction marker.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for compass icons when the vertical pole and two arrow signs matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a pole with two stacked arrow signs pointing in opposite directions.

items.depicts_observation: Single road sign panel on a short vertical post with a pointed right end
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants one simple direction sign instead of a full two way signpost.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two arrow signpost when the icon should stay as one right pointed panel.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot simplifies the signpost into one arrow ended sign panel on a short post.
